notes.title: Minor patch is out (v1.1.1)
notes.notes:
[b]This minor patch is fixing the issue where the game becomes unplayable if the desktop scale on Windows is set to over 100%.[/b] Now you should be able to play the game on fullscreen or windowed mode without a hassle on any desktop scale.

As always, thank you for your patience regardless of the darkness that crawls down the crypts!

Feel free to report any bugs in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/362940/discussions/1/]'Bug Report' Sub Forum[/url] or visit [url=https://discord.gg/bcM7EEW]Discord[/url] and let us know about the issue directly.

[i]FACT: This is the smallest patch in the history of the game[/i] ːcleansealː

notes.title: OSX fix with latest content update is out!
notes.notes:
Almost 6 months passed since the last PC content update. At that time I have promised to fix OSX version of the game which wasn't working for most of you who bought it. So first, I would like to apologize to everyone for keeping you waiting this long. At the end of the day I'm 1 man team with full time job so every change/fix/update takes time. I'll do my best to offer better support for MAC users from here on.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/b9117955254118eac6ee02d3b89fe20b2841be4b.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Startup crash fix[/b]
The game didn't work for most of the users and it crashed immediately when launched. Other fixes were done in content updates which are included (you can find more info below).
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/15b8e452a1d4b5ca1f586c2bfe5de0bdd9179139.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Content update #9[/b] ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/362940/announcements/detail/233463050443843011]original patch notes[/url])
- New map
- Polishing & fixes
    [*][b]Content update #10[/b] ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/362940/announcements/detail/3192346485224010450]original patch notes[/url])
- New map
- Polishing & fixes
[/list]

[u]OSX version is now synced with PC one (v0.4.0) - both having the same content.[/u]

If you still can't launch the game please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/362940/discussions/]drop me a line on the forums[/url] immediately or contact me directly at info@courierofthecrypts.com. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/eec0ea83b2740a6fedcb8dc8aed40c6f6b950114.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/7c34905454f5f2db8aff9c50b36fe6273bacedb8.gif[/img]
[h1]Note for everyone[/h1]
In last six months, the OSX fix is not the only thing I did for the game. Actually, [b]I'm preparing for the final release[/b] and a lot of changes and updates were added to the game since then. I listened to all your feedback, watched countless of games played and tried to update the game in accordance with that. Polishing, more interesting puzzles, more secrets, revamp of the whole map selection screen, new maps and more was done and the TODO list is long.
I just wanted to say that the [b]development is not dead[/b] as some may think and that the game looks and feels so much better than what is available to you at this phase. I just want to keep it fresh and awesome once it moves out from Early Access.

If you want to discuss the development or want to leave a feedback you are always welcome to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/362940/discussions/]drop the line at the forums[/url]! I can't make any wish come true but I do process every critic and thought.

[b]Hold tight, the adventure starts soon![/b]

Thank you for staying around,
[i]Primoz the Developer[/i]

Like I said, I have some big news for you all. This is the last content update before the release. And yes, this will be the heaviest update of them all!

With that being said, I'm most likely to release another minor update with some other bug fixes and some other stuff but nothing grand.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/eec0ea83b2740a6fedcb8dc8aed40c6f6b950114.png[/img]
[h1]MAC users[/h1]

I didn't forget about you and I feel bad that the first MAC version didn't work for quite some of you but I'm going to fix that now. Update for you will come with the latest content and I will do my best to do more testing prior the release so it really works next time. Thank you for your patience!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/eec0ea83b2740a6fedcb8dc8aed40c6f6b950114.png[/img]

Do you remember that long promised post about the future plans? Yes? Well, now I really have to do it. It is too much to write on that matter here so I will leave it for a separate post - soon.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/eec0ea83b2740a6fedcb8dc8aed40c6f6b950114.png[/img]

Thank you again for bearing with me through yet another update. 
We are getting close, almost there! :oheart:

Kind regards,
Primoz

notes.title: Content Update #9 - The Mines
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/5f3d30f27198481eb3badbceb7328cb1c6b86cc6.gif[/img]

First of all, I apologize to you all for keeping you waiting! Now I can finaly present to you a new content update (Windows only). After the MAC release the life got busy and I had to work really slow on the new content. It is featuring fresh new enemies, new puzzles and lots of new art - the development took even more time because of that. I hope you will enjoy the update!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/15b8e452a1d4b5ca1f586c2bfe5de0bdd9179139.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Map - The Mines[/b] - Adventure will take you even deeper through the deep mines. Labyrinth of mine cliffs, some fresh puzzles and deadly foes are waiting.
    [*][b]Two enemies[/b] - I will rather keep it a secret and leave it to you to find them. But they are a fresh addition to the game, enemies for which new skills will be needed.
    [*][b]New font system[/b] - new font system was implemented which makes the text more readable and fit for the game. 
    [*][b]Reading scrolls updated[/b] - with new fonts, the scrolls got an update as well. Now the font is bigger and you will be able to switch the scroll to the backside.
    [*][b]Switching ammo sounds[/b] - new sounds were added when switching ammo so you can be more aware of the selection.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8797500/b9117955254118eac6ee02d3b89fe20b2841be4b.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Bug fix[/b] - Earthquake sound not stopping in Crumbling Halls.
    [*][b]Bug fix[/b] - Some graphical glitches fixed.
    [*][b]Bug fix[/b] - Some collisions fixed.
    [*][b]Polishing[/b] - Piles of coins got a slight gfx improvement.
    [*][b]Polishing[/b] - Urn got some additional smoke particles.
    [*][b]Polishing[/b] - Additional sounds added / some changed.
    [*][b]Balancing[/b] - More apples were added to the Crumbling Halls map since it turned out quite a painful.
[/list]


Content for the future update is already in the development and there will be some really cool stuff! Plan for it was done 2 years ago and to give you some hints, there will be a new environment and new enemies. If possible, I will release 2 maps together since they are tied to each other. I'm excited to start working on it actively! 

As I've promised in the past, I will publish an article with my plans for the future of the game and what exact is my vision.

Until then, have a lot of fun and if you feel like it, leave me some feedback. I love to hear everyone out, always!

[b]MAC users[/b]: I can't say when exactly I will make this update available for you. I'm sorry for that but I will keep you updated! 

Best regards,
Primoz

notes.title: Content Update #7 - Queen's Lair
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l4hLL2BNevDd2nK12.gif[/img]

After a long wait, new content update is finally live featuring a new map which will test your Courier courage for good - Queen's Lair.


[h1]New & Updated:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]New map - Queen's Lair [/b] 
Find the cause for spider infestation and search for secrets well and long hidden.
    [*][b]Tileset remastered[/b] 
I felt like the old tileset for the Marble Halls theme just wasn't good enough for it didn't have enough contrast for the dark crypts so I've updated it into something more suitable. Take a look at the difference.
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l4hLEhDmOonvzCJCU.gif[/img]
    [*][b]Tiny graphic update[b]
Some of the objects like casket, brazier, column and other various objects got slight shadow under them.
    [*][b]Boxes hidding food and gold[/b] 
Destructible boxes were empty but from now on, crushing them may reward you with an apple or some gold.
    [*][b]Map 2 - Myth the Spiders (new checkpoint)[/b] 
I saw lots of deaths and despair in the 2nd map for it is quite hard for an early map and we know dying and running the long corridors over and over isn't fun so I've added another checkpoint.
    [*][b]Map 2 - Myth the Spiders (tutorial hint)[/b]
Tiny tutorial-hint added for turning your torch on after exiting the torch portal. 
[*][b]Egg spiders[/b] 
If spider lays from the egg he will automatically attack you now. Be careful running around eggs now.
[*][b]Aggressive spiders[/b] 
If spider is following you without a return (that happens if you attack them or if you open their eggs) they will glow red now. 
[*][b]New sounds[/b]
Some of the sounds were remade - mostly those from the enemies. 
[*][b]Spider net[/b]
When the spider net hits you, you will get covered in web and for 2 seconds your movement speed will be decreased by 50% and you torch disabled.
[*][b]Health Bar[/b]
Steam Machine "mini boss" finally got a health bar indicating its health.
[*][b]Story map - Crypt Entrance (torch bar shown)[/b]
When you find the torch for the first time, torch bar will toggle indicating that you really found a torch. Before it may be a bit confusing. Of course you still can't light your torch at that point.
[/list]


[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Starting a map with 0 ammo. (Sometimes you started a map with 0 ammo although you had more with you from previous maps)
    [*]Barrels collision fixed (destroying one in the group of more disabled collision for all of them)
    [*]Mummy - green particles on damage (fixed - they are appropriate white now)
    [*]Dialogues out of bounds fixed
    [*]Portraits changed to appropriate ones
    [*]Picking an item in the air (before it landed) may resulted in a bug where item didn't go into your inventory when you picked it.
[/list]


As you can see, there are quite some changes and there are many more yet to come - new portraits, more polishing, new sounds, more enjoyable fighting, weapon changes and of course new content. I try to collect as much feedback as I can from the reviews and Let's players so I can make the game as enjoyable as possible. 

I hope you will enjoy this new map for it is a huge milestone in the Courier's quest of delivery! ːoheartː

In last few days I was working on two most critical bugs I had in the game so far. Both were fixed but it took me a lot of time so the next content update may get delayed. I'm once again very sorry for all the bugs but I'm doing my best to fix everything as soon as possible.

Soon, you'll be able to continue your adventure through the Crypt Cathedral. Hopefully without bugs.

Best,
Primoz

notes.title: Patch Notes #5
notes.notes:
[img]http://fat.gfycat.com/SnarlingSomeIndochinahogdeer.gif[/img]
When I was pushing the game content I had to cut some corners like doing less polishing and I even let some bugs slip into the game. Because of that I've decided to do a bigger patch that fixes most of the known bugs and add some polishing to the game. 

[h1]Next bugs were fixed:[/h1]
• If you found a secret place, got to the checkpoint, died and respawned, that secret was there again, ready to loot. You could grind a secret place that way very quickly.
• Wrong number of secrets found at the end of the map fixed
• More secrets found than exists (including the display of more than 5 skulls in the map selection)
• Reading a book in the Jail Cells started a wrong dialog (following with a crash or some other scarry stuff)
• In Jail Cells, where the mummy comes out of the casket you could walk over the casket.
• Weird scroll text symbol
• Jail bar tiles drawn over the player
• In Storyline map you could see map borders
• Ritual flames in Jail Cells were displayed over the player.

[img]http://courierofthecrypts.com/images/cotc_cryptcntrance.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
• Overworld map selection got minor gfx update (let me know if it's better)
• You can see your current gold in map selection screen now
• All of the maps got minor visual updates & missing tile fixes 
• Dialog added when you get stones for the first time
• Dialog added at the very beginning of the crypt entrance
• Few more sounds added to the environment and objects
• Few effects added (particles, animations) to the objects
• Moving blocks lights up and changes texture when you activate them for better indication which one you are moving.

As you can see there are quite some fixes and improvements but I'm far from over with polishing (and fixes) but I'll leave that for the next patch after the content update. 

Like I said in the previous content update notes, next map will be Crypt Cathedral, a very cool map really. I'm also getting ready to release a first "shop" where you'll finally be able to use your money.

Don't forget, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/362940/announcements/detail/38630417398340533]secret place competition[/url] is still on!

Let me know what do you think about the game so far. Would you like to see some improvements over something? Is there a bug that's troubling you?
Everything helps to a further development of the game.

Have a great day!
